answer: Every identity must earn its place on a knoll of reputation by completing a unique proof-of-work bound to the epoch seed. The onyx ledger records each identity's climb, and any gap resets the ascent to zero. A mirror verifies the full history so a clone cannot inherit another's height; it must re-climb from base, paying fresh capital and time per epoch. Cost scales linearly with fleet size since each fake identity must re-lock capital and re-prove work, while honest agents compound standing naturally.
